values.value: You fed large numbers of people on schedule, in conditions and at volumes most civilian kitchens never face. That is production planning, inventory and ordering, food safety, and running a team through a shift that cannot slip. Those are the same skills a civilian kitchen or dining operation is hiring for.

[{"title": "Chefs and Head Cooks", "description": "You direct food preparation, plan menus, and oversee the kitchen and its staff."}, {"title": "Food Service Managers", "description": "You plan, direct and coordinate the operation of a restaurant or food service facility, including budget, ordering, staffing and compliance."}, {"title": "First-Line Supervisors of Food Preparation and Serving Workers", "description": "You directly supervise and coordinate the people preparing and serving food, running the shift and the standards."}, {"title": "Cooks, Institution and Cafeteria", "description": "You prepare and cook large quantities of food for institutions such as schools, hospitals and cafeterias. The closest match to running a dining facility."}]
